raw:
@q query
  where match
    relation "order"
    role subject "Cosmina"
    role object "the laptop"
    role source "eMAG"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be delivered by"
    role subject "the laptop"
    role instrument "Sameday"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "arrive at"
    role subject "the laptop"
    role destination "the easybox at Kaufland"
    polarity affirmed
  end
